name: f3-missing-not-clean
alt: Top: a record of seven passages with the fifth missing. A reader that trusts the record looks only at the record, passes the gap and says fine. Bottom: the source capture, all seven passages. probity-verify pairs each source passage with its passage in the record, finds the fifth has none, and returns contradicted, reason selected_span_missing_from_record. The two verdicts sit in one column.
